items.title: Only two retrieved studies
items.whyItMatters: The first search failed and the second found two records; the five leads are unchecked.
items.opportunity: Check the leads by identifier before citing them and report the thin evidence plainly.

items.title: Falls cannot be powered at this scale
items.whyItMatters: The retrieved trial of 412 people found no difference in falls (c3).
items.opportunity: Make attendance primary and report falls descriptively.

items.title: People without a mobile phone or with limited English
items.whyItMatters: Text reminders exclude some older adults; phone calls in the right language are needed.
items.opportunity: Offer phone calls as the default for anyone without a mobile phone and record language.

items.title: Contamination within classes
items.whyItMatters: Supported and unsupported participants share classes and may share encouragement.
items.opportunity: Accept some contamination as part of the pragmatic question and report it.

errorsFound: The need's 'first searches found almost nothing' matches the record: one failed search and one search with two hits; the leads are not evidence.
reevaluation: The gaps support an individually allocated pragmatic trial with attendance as the primary outcome.
summary: Four gaps; thin retrieved evidence is high severity.
